name: Dizayn
tagline: A gallery of design furniture and collectible objects

seo.title: Dizayn — design furniture gallery in Tashkent
seo.description: Design furniture, lighting and collectible objects by makers from Uzbekistan and Europe. A new show every two months, buy from the floor or to order, delivery nationwide.
seo.answer: Dizayn is a design furniture gallery in Tashkent (52 Shota Rustaveli Street). It shows and sells furniture, lighting and collectible objects by makers from Uzbekistan and Europe: armchairs from UZS 9,500,000, lamps from UZS 2,800,000. Shows change every two months; open Tuesday to Sunday, 11–20.

listing.description: A site for a design gallery or a showroom of designer-made furniture: a full-width name, a piece with a museum label, an index of shows, a showcase of works and a section for collectors.

sections.title: Furniture people collect
sections.eyebrow: “Chinar” armchair · Bakhtiyor Karimov, 2026 · walnut, leather · one of a kind
sections.subtitle: Twenty pieces by eight makers in the “Warm Wood” show. Touch them, sit on them and buy them — from the floor or made to order in your colour.

sections.label: Gallery
sections.title: A showroom that shows furniture as art
sections.text: We select furniture and lighting from small workshops and makers: every piece is handmade, in editions of up to 20 or as one-offs. Every two months we change the display, tell the maker’s story and help you fit the piece into your interior.

items.title: Warm Wood
items.text: Armchairs, tables and benches from workshops in Tashkent and Samarkand.

items.title: Light and Clay
items.text: Lamps of Rishtan clay in contemporary shapes.

items.title: Soft Form
items.text: Upholstered pieces from shows in Milan and Copenhagen.

items.title: From the floor
items.text: Take the piece after the show closes, or earlier with a sample in its place.

items.title: Made to order
items.text: In your size, wood and fabric. 30–60 days.

items.title: Interior advice
items.text: The gallery’s designer visits and selects pieces for your project.

items.quote: We came to see the show and left with an armchair. It is now the centrepiece of our living room.
items.author: Shakhnoza

items.quote: They helped choose lighting and a console for our restaurant and delivered on time.
items.author: Rustam

items.a: No, the gallery is open to everyone Tuesday to Sunday, 11–20.

items.q: Can I buy a piece before the show ends?
items.a: Yes, we reserve it for you; collect it after the show, or straight away if the maker provides a replacement.

items.q: Do you deliver to the regions?
items.a: Yes, crated in wood and insured. The cost depends on weight and distance.

items.q: How can I show my work here?
items.a: Send your portfolio on Telegram; the curator replies within a week.

sections.label: Visit

sections.text: 52 Shota Rustaveli, Tue–Sun 11–20. Message us on Telegram for a private viewing outside opening hours.
